# secureaccess_lander_setting (Data Source)

This data source reads a Lander Setting, found by its `id` or by its `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_lander_setting" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Lander Setting.

### Read-Only

- `contact_form` (Boolean) Specifies whether the contact form is enabled.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Lander Setting.
- `is_swg_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Lander Setting for the secure web gateway (SWG). The API returns null if it is not set, which is read as `false`.
- `show_diagnostic_info` (Boolean) Specifies whether diagnostic information is shown.
